name: Cadbury
verdict: Cadbury is a brand owned by US-listed Mondelez International. No state link in the chain; no qualifying human-rights finding against Mondelez located. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Cadbury is a Mondelez International brand (Sportcal, 2024: 'owned by USA-based snack company Mondelez International'; RA's renewal names Darren O'Brien as Mondelez International President for Australia, New Zealand and Japan and 'custodians of Cadbury'). Mondelez International is a US-listed company (NASDAQ: MDLZ) with a dispersed institutional register; no state control, 5%+ state stake or state board seat found. Records checked: the 2021 International Rights Advocates lawsuit in Washington DC naming Mondelez among cocoa companies (Guardian, 12 Feb 2021) and a further IRA suit filed in DC Superior Court in December 2023 (Morningstar Sustainalytics ESG blog) are allegations, not findings; the related Nestle/Cargill case was blocked by the US Supreme Court in 2021 (BBC). No court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO finding against Mondelez in scope was located.
